job.title: Interior Design & Innovation Manager
job.description:
Vivid Recruitment has been exclusively engaged by a well-established residential builder to find its next Interior Design & Innovation Manager.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who loves design and people in equal measure. You'll lead the studio, set the direction for display homes and new product, and help decide what homeowners will be choosing in the years ahead.

THE OPPORTUNITY

You'll report to the General Manager of Operations and work closely with the senior leadership team. The studio includes an Interior Design Team Leader, a Technical Lead, Interior Designers, Junior Interior Designers and a Selections Administration Assistant.

The role splits into two parts. You'll lead a capable team, and you'll steer the creative and commercial direction of the product. Both matter, and the right person will enjoy both.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  • Leading, developing and inspiring the interior design team, including recruitment, performance and leave
  • Building a positive studio culture where people can grow and progress
  • Creating mood boards, colour schemes and flat lays for display homes and special projects
  • Researching and sourcing new and trending products for the studio and display homes
  • Reading current trends and anticipating future ones, based on who the clients are and where they're building
  • Working with Marketing on renders, collateral and display home content
  • Sourcing furniture for display homes
  • Representing the business in media and social media interviews
  • Attending supplier functions, events and product sessions
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
  • At least five years in a design studio at manager level, within residential new home construction
  • A diploma or degree in interior design or a related discipline
  • Strong leadership skills, with a genuine interest in developing people
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to build lasting relationships
  • A strong eye for trends, balanced with commercial awareness
  • Excellent organisation and time management
  • Experience with Framework and Salesforce is highly regarded
WORTH KNOWING

This role suits someone comfortable with the rhythm of residential building. Some weekend work is required, and there will be occasional contact outside standard hours. We'd rather be upfront about that now than surprise you later.

WHY THIS ROLE?

Plenty of design manager roles look after process. This one also shapes the product. You'll have real influence over what the business offers, how its display homes look, and how its studio grows. For an experienced studio leader ready for a broader remit, it's a rare opportunity.

SALARY
$140-150,000 + Super

job.title: Project Architect
job.description:
Our client, a well-regarded Brisbane architecture practice, has opened a new Melbourne studio and is looking for one, possibly two, Project Architects to help it grow.

The Melbourne team will be delivering luxury multi-residential projects in Queensland. You'll be based in Melbourne, with trips up to Brisbane from time to time.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Joining a new office early is a very different experience from joining an established one. You'll have a genuine say in how the studio works, the culture it builds and the people who join after you.

This is a role for a confident all-rounder. Someone who understands design intent, can hold onto it through documentation and delivery, and takes pride in seeing a building finished properly.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  • Running luxury multi-residential projects from design through to completion
  • Translating design intent into well-resolved documentation in Revit
  • Coordinating consultants, builders and client teams
  • Mentoring and supporting less experienced members of the studio
  • Helping establish the Melbourne office's processes and culture
  • Travelling to Brisbane when projects require it
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
  • Extensive multi-residential project experience, ideally at the higher end of the market
  • Strong Revit skills (essential)
  • A solid grasp of design, and the ability to carry it through every stage
  • Experience running projects and coordinating consultant teams
  • A willingness to mentor and share what you know
  • A practical, well-rounded approach to architecture
WHY THIS ROLE?

Most Project Architect roles slot you into an existing structure. This one lets you help build it. You'll have the backing of an established practice, the energy of a new studio, and a portfolio of quality multi-residential work to lead.
